result.explanation: S3 Bucket "{logicalId}" is being deleted. This may cause permanent data loss.
result.recommendation: Verify the bucket is empty or has a RemovalPolicy.RETAIN. Confirm with the team before deploying.

result.explanation: DynamoDB Table "{logicalId}" is being replaced. Replacement destroys all existing data.
result.recommendation: Export the table data first. Consider using a blue/green strategy or adding a RemovalPolicy.

result.explanation: IAM resource "{logicalId}" contains wildcard (*) permissions, granting excessive access.
result.recommendation: Replace wildcards with specific actions and resources. Use least-privilege IAM policies.

result.explanation: KMS Key "{logicalId}" policy is being modified or deleted. This can break encryption and make data unreadable.
result.recommendation: Review key policy changes carefully. Ensure all encrypted resources retain access.

result.explanation: S3 Bucket "{logicalId}" may be gaining public access. This could expose sensitive data.
result.recommendation: Ensure S3 Block Public Access is enabled unless this bucket is intentionally public (e.g., static website).

result.explanation: Security Group "{logicalId}" allows traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 (open to the internet).
result.recommendation: Restrict ingress rules to known IP ranges or VPC CIDRs.

result.explanation: DynamoDB Table "{logicalId}" is being deleted. All data will be lost.
result.recommendation: Back up the table before deleting. Set RemovalPolicy.RETAIN for production tables.

result.explanation: AppSync resource "{logicalId}" is being modified. Auth mode changes can break existing API clients.
result.recommendation: Review auth mode and resolver changes. Test API clients after deployment.

result.explanation: API Gateway "{logicalId}" authorization config is being changed. Endpoints may become exposed.
result.recommendation: Confirm the desired auth configuration and test endpoints after deployment.

result.explanation: Cognito resource "{logicalId}" is being modified. User pool changes can affect authentication flows.
result.recommendation: Test login/signup flows after deployment. Some changes require user re-authentication.

result.explanation: Lambda function "{logicalId}" environment variables are changing. Secret or config values may be affected.
result.recommendation: Verify that new environment variables are correct and secrets are properly managed in SSM or Secrets Manager.

result.explanation: {category} resource "{logicalId}" is being deleted. Dependent services may be affected.
result.recommendation: Confirm no other services depend on this resource before deploying.

result.explanation: IAM resource "{logicalId}" is being {changeType}. Permission changes can affect service access.
result.recommendation: Review the diff carefully. Ensure least-privilege is maintained.
Verify the new code is tested. Consider using Lambda aliases for gradual deployment.

result.explanation: Resource "{logicalId}" ({resourceType}) is being replaced, causing downtime during deployment.
result.recommendation: Replacing a resource causes it to be deleted and re-created. Plan for downtime.
